title: Estate agent ordered to pay £790 over undisclosed buyer
summary:
The Property Ombudsman has ordered an estate agent to compensate buyers £790 after failing to disclose the existence of a competing purchaser during a property transaction. The case highlights transparency obligations under industry codes of practice.

title: Digital signatures uptake stalls in conveyancing sector
summary:
The implementation of Qualified Electronic Signatures for property transactions has faced significant challenges, with only five registrable dispositions completed in the first quarter of 2026. Industry experts have warned that current Land Registry guidance contains fundamental flaws hampering adoption across the conveyancing sector.

The post Digital signatures uptake stalls in conveyancing sector appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Landlords face first Making Tax Digital deadline
summary:
Landlords and sole traders face the first Making Tax Digital quarterly deadline on 7th August, with accountants warning that confusion remains over the new requirements. The scheme became mandatory from April 2026 for those with qualifying income above £50,000.

The post Landlords face first Making Tax Digital deadline appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Scottish landlords face year-long tribunal delays
summary:
Landlords in Scotland are experiencing waits of up to 12 months to regain possession of their properties through the housing tribunal system, according to legal practitioners. Law firm Aberdein Considine reports that landlords are typically waiting between eight and 12 months from submitting an eviction application to receiving a tribunal hearing, with legal costs reaching approximately £10,000 before cases conclude.

The post Scottish landlords face year-long tribunal delays appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Knight Frank creates board-level lettings role
summary:
Knight Frank has appointed Mike Knowles to the newly created board-level position of Head of Lettings Business Development, consolidating several operational divisions under unified leadership. Knowles joins from CBRE after 12 years, most recently as Head of Residential Agency.

The post Knight Frank creates board-level lettings role appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Housing supply steady as buyers delay purchase decisions
summary:
Buyers are taking longer to commit to property purchases despite steady supply levels, according to data from Landmark Information Group covering the second quarter of 2026. The research indicates listing volumes across England and Wales remained only 1% lower than the same period in 2025.

The post Housing supply steady as buyers delay purchase decisions appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Aldermore provides £85m facility for London rental portfolio
summary:
Aldermore has provided an £85 million commercial real estate facility to support Brydell Partners' acquisition of a 325-unit residential portfolio across London. The five-year interest-only facility enabled the acquisition of five residential schemes in Waltham Forest, Ealing and Wandsworth.

The post Aldermore provides £85m facility for London rental portfolio appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Fine & Country appoints advisor for French expansion
summary:
Fine & Country has appointed Sébastien Tedesco as consultant and advisor to support the estate agency network's expansion into the French market. Separately, build-to-rent provider Leaf Living has named David Mullin as chief financial officer.

The post Fine & Country appoints advisor for French expansion appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Solo first-time buyers face nine years of saving
summary:
First-time buyers purchasing property alone in England require an average of 113 months to save for a deposit and upfront costs, according to analysis of over 40,000 conveyancing quote forms. The research reveals that solo buyers need to accumulate £27,315 to secure a property at the average first-time buyer price of £250,000.

The post Solo first-time buyers face nine years of saving appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: UK build-to-rent investment hits £3bn in first half
summary:
Investment in the UK build-to-rent sector reached £3bn during the first half of 2026, marking the second-strongest start to a year on record. However, funding for new multifamily development has fallen to its lowest level since at least 2015.
